name: Qwibi
description: Pay-per-request AI analyst desk for agentic finance. Agents pay with x402 on Algorand for finished, cited, and cryptographically attested analyst deliverables.

endpoints.description: Generate an attested wallet financial statement from one or more wallet addresses.
Generate a cited crypto and equity market intelligence brief.
Generate a time-series forecast or rule-based strategy backtest.
Clean raw CSV, JSON, or on-chain data into a workbook and quality report.
Generate a DCF workbook with live formulas and a summary.
Generate a researched report, proposal, case study, or writeup.
Answer a safe read-only SQL question or turn CSV data into a dashboard.
Verify a Qwibi deliverable by job id or SHA-256 attestation hash.
